params.name: userAddresses
params.description: Optional. Filter to specific Polymarket trade addresses.

params.name: conditionID
params.description: Optional. Filter to a single market condition ID (all of its outcome tokens).

params.name: eventID
params.description: Optional. Filter to all markets and outcomes in a Polymarket event.

params.name: tokenAddresses
params.description: Optional. Filter to specific outcome token addresses. The conditionID, eventID, and tokenAddresses filters are intersected (a token must satisfy all provided).

params.name: minUsd
params.description: Optional. Minimum notional (size * price) in whole USD.

params.name: maxUsd
params.description: Optional. Maximum notional (size * price) in whole USD.

params.name: minPrice
params.description: Optional. Minimum per-share price as a 0-1 fraction.

params.name: maxPrice
params.description: Optional. Maximum per-share price as a 0-1 fraction.

params.name: minSize
params.description: Optional. Minimum trade size in whole outcome-token shares.

params.name: maxSize
params.description: Optional. Maximum trade size in whole outcome-token shares.

params.name: actions
params.description: Optional. Filter to one or more actions: buy, sell, split, merge, convert. Cannot be combined with eventType or direction.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Optional. Filter by event class: trade, split, merge, or convert. Use direction to narrow trades to one side.

params.name: direction
params.description: Optional. Narrow trades to one side: buy or sell. Only valid with eventType=trade (or no eventType).

params.name: startTime
params.description: Optional. Unix timestamp in seconds for the start of the range (inclusive).

params.name: endTime
params.description: Optional. Unix timestamp in seconds for the end of the range (exclusive).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results (default 50, max 500).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for pagination (default 0).

params.name: fastPagination
params.description: Fast pagination defaults to true. When enabled, totalCount is only large enough to determine whether another page exists; set false to count matches up to 10,000.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Column to order by: time (default), size (outcome-token shares), price (cents-per-share), usd (notional).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort direction: asc or desc (default).

items.docs: Returns the Polymarket total-PnL leaderboard (realized plus unrealized) for a period: 1d, 1w, 1m, or all (default 1d). Order desc for top traders or asc for worst. Pass an address to also receive that trader's rank.

params.name: userAddress
params.description: Polymarket trade address (0x + 40 hex chars).

params.name: conditionID
params.description: Optional. Market condition ID (0x-prefixed bytes32 hex). Aggregates across all outcome tokens. Omit for portfolio-level PnL.

params.name: period
params.description: Time period: 24h, 7d, 30d, all. Presets auto-shrink to the wallet's available history; all is portfolio-only. Default: 30d

params.name: startTime
params.description: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds for start of range. Not supported with period=all. Condition-level custom ranges must be 30 days or less; all condition-level fixed windows must start within the last 30 days.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds for end of range. For conditionID requests, preset windows derived from endTime must start within the last 30 days.

items.docs: Returns a time series of cumulative PnL for a trade address — portfolio-wide, or for a single market when `conditionID` is set. Window follows the `period` preset or an explicit `startTime`/`endTime` range.

params.name: addr
params.description: Required. Polymarket trade address (0x + 40 hex chars).

items.docs: Returns a trade address's current open positions, one row per outcome token, with net position, net USDC flow, last price, and unrealized PnL. Sort by trades (default), shares, value, or pnl. Supports offset pagination.

params.name: tokenAddress
params.description: Polymarket token address (0x-prefixed hex). Provide exactly one of tokenAddress or conditionID.

params.name: conditionID
params.description: Market condition ID (0x-prefixed bytes32 hex). Returns prices for the first outcome (outcome_index=0) token. Provide exactly one of tokenAddress or conditionID.

params.name: interval
params.description: Price interval: 1s, 5s, 1m, 1h, 1d, auto. Default: 1h. 1s and 5s require startTime and endTime, with a maximum 2-hour span, and return a dense series carrying the last price forward across quiet periods.

params.name: range
params.description: Window selector anchored on the token's last bucket: 1d, 1w, 1m, all. Server picks the granularity. Overrides startTime, endTime and interval except interval=1s or interval=5s, which cannot be combined with range.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds for start of range. Ignored when range is set.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Optional Unix timestamp in seconds for end of range. Ignored when range is set.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of price points to return (1-7500). Default: 500, or 7500 for interval=1s and interval=5s. When the requested window holds more points than limit, the newest points are returned.

items.docs: Returns a midprice time series for a single Polymarket outcome token, identified by either `tokenAddress` or `conditionID` (not both).
